title: Spartacus's Way Out

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You lost?

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: If you're here to ask me to take him back, you can keep walking. He's the one who quit on this sport.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're here to ask me to take him back, you can keep walking. He's the one who quit on this sport.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Heart's got nothing to do with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heart's got nothing to do with it.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: I got Lims riding on the OB4 bout. That’s what I told Doom and that’s what I’m telling you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got Lims riding on the OB4 bout. That’s what I told Doom and that’s what I’m telling you.
He knew the risks.
Not open to negotiation.
Or what? What'll you do?

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: There's only one thing I want right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's only one thing I want right now.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: A fighter who can actually fight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A fighter who can actually fight.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: There are noises coming out of your mouth that I don't like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are noises coming out of your mouth that I don't like.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: For the last time, no. Now, get out of my face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For the last time, no. Now, get out of my face.
Sure.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Maybe I woulda said yes. But you threaten me with the 'Sec, you don't get to make offers. Get out of here, we're done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I woulda said yes. But you threaten me with the 'Sec, you don't get to make offers. Get out of here, we're done.
That! And ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I need to talk to you about Spartacus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I need to talk to you about Spartacus.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I need to talk to you about Spartacus.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I need to talk to you about Spartacus.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe because his heart's not in it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe because his heart's not in it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe because his heart's not in it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe because his heart's not in it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, let him quit.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're just going to watch him get pulverized by Obliterata Four?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're just going to watch him get pulverized by Obliterata Four?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're just going to watch him get pulverized by Obliterata Four?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're just going to watch him get pulverized by Obliterata Four?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He might die.
Alright, how many Lims?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There has to be a way to work this out. What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There has to be a way to work this out. What do you want?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There has to be a way to work this out. What do you want?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There has to be a way to work this out. What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Release him from his contract.
Report you to CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can give you something you want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can give you something you want.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can give you something you want.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can give you something you want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Name it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will you tear up Spartacus's contract?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will you tear up Spartacus's contract?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will you tear up Spartacus's contract?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will you tear up Spartacus's contract?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I shouldn't have said that. There must be some way I can convince you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I shouldn't have said that. There must be some way I can convince you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I shouldn't have said that. There must be some way I can convince you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I shouldn't have said that. There must be some way I can convince you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I find you another fighter, you'll tear up Spartacus's contract?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I find you another fighter, you'll tear up Spartacus's contract?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I find you another fighter, you'll tear up Spartacus's contract?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I find you another fighter, you'll tear up Spartacus's contract?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me gone?
